meta.title: MeloBreed — breed melodies by ear
meta.description: Listen to eight melodies, pick the ones you like, and breed the next generation. No AI training data. Export MIDI to your DAW.

hero.title: Breed melodies by ear
hero.lead: Listen to eight melodies and pick the ones you like. The next generation is bred from your picks. When one clicks, take it to your DAW as MIDI.
hero.noTrainingNote: No model trained on anyone's songs. Melodies grow from music-theory rules and your choices alone.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what MeloBreed (operated by [OPERATOR NAME]) collects and why.
privacy.browser: Your settings and the melodies you breed are saved in your browser's local storage so you can pick up where you left off. They are not sent to us.
privacy.analyticsTitle: Usage analytics (only if you allow it)
privacy.analytics: If you allow analytics, we record events such as starting a session, playing a melody, breeding a generation, exporting MIDI and opening the Pro page, with an anonymous ID stored in your browser. We use PostHog to process these events. If you decline, nothing is recorded. You can change your choice at any time from "Analytics settings" at the bottom of the page.
privacy.email: If you join the Pro waitlist, we store your email address, the language you used and where you signed up. We use it only to tell you when Pro launches. It is stored with Supabase.
privacy.hosting: The site is hosted on Vercel, which processes request data such as IP addresses to serve pages.
privacy.rights: You can decline or withdraw analytics consent at any time, and ask us to delete your waitlist email.
